quotes.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
quotes.flavor:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

quotes.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

quotes.name: Diabolic Intent
quotes.flavor:
"Alas for Saruman! The palantir was his downfall, I now perceive. Perilous to us all are the devices of an art deeper than we possess ourselves."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Vulshok Berserker
quotes.flavor: He will carve out a legend for himself with his own two hands.

quotes.name: Bone Splinters
quotes.flavor: "Looks like they're just piling on now."

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Vow of Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

quotes.name: Necroduality
quotes.flavor:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor: "The elements marshal their infinite might at my beckoning! Power seethes in the roiling clouds! Now, at my command-STRIKE!"

quotes.name: Council's Judgment
quotes.flavor: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

quotes.name: Taii Wakeen, Perfect Shot
quotes.flavor: "You'd best keep yourself out of my sights."

quotes.name: Sagu Archer
quotes.flavor: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.

quotes.name: Ultimecia, Time Sorceress // Ultimecia, Omnipotent
quotes.flavor: "Time... it will not wait... no matter how hard you hold on. It escapes you..."

quotes.name: Ghosts of the Damned
quotes.flavor: The voices of the dead ring in the heart long after they have faded from the ears.

quotes.name: Fireball
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

quotes.name: Tocasia's Welcome
quotes.flavor: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

quotes.name: Angelic Purge
quotes.flavor: "We must save you from yourselves."

quotes.name: Hobgoblin, Mantled Marauder
quotes.flavor:
"Alrighty, let's see who's behind the mask this time. Kingsley, is that you?"
—Spider-Man

quotes.name: Rotting Giant
quotes.flavor: Wracked with rot, it wrecks and ruins.

quotes.name: Orcish Bloodpainter
quotes.flavor: Blood calls to blood.

quotes.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

quotes.name: Foriysian Interceptor
quotes.flavor: A focal point for time rifts, Foriys contends simultaneously with foes both new and old.

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor:
"An ordered Sothera is a peaceful Sothera. Join the Strategic Corps today and proudly turn the gears of progress!"
—Pinnacle recruitment ad

quotes.name: Tidespout Tyrant
quotes.flavor: He unmakes the world in his own image.

quotes.name: Undead Sprinter
quotes.flavor: Farley had always been the fastest on the track team. But no one was cheering anymore.

quotes.name: Stitched Drake
quotes.flavor:
"The best skaabs are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

quotes.name: Kodama's Reach
quotes.flavor:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
quotes.flavor: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

quotes.name: Magmatic Force
quotes.flavor:
"Granted, it's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness. So what would you call *two* of them?"
—Riku of Two Reflections

quotes.name: Kagemaro's Clutch
quotes.flavor: The mist was thick, cloying, and constricting. Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

quotes.name: Voyager Glidecar
quotes.flavor: "Exclamatory: Hang on to something."

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor: "Me wildest dreams finally come true!"

quotes.name: Clear Shot
quotes.flavor: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

quotes.name: Great-Horn Krushok
quotes.flavor: Perfectly suited for life in the Shifting Wastes, the krushok is well protected by its horn, its hide, and its temper.

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor:
"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Master Thief
quotes.flavor: Possession is ten-tenths of the law.

quotes.name: Revenant
quotes.flavor:
"Not again."
—Hans

quotes.name: Sanguine Bond
quotes.flavor:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Brineborn Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

quotes.name: Feldon's Cane
quotes.flavor: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Valorous Steed
quotes.flavor: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.

quotes.name: Assassin's Trophy
quotes.flavor:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

quotes.name: Electropotence
quotes.flavor: Where life and force collide.

quotes.name: Stormscape Familiar
quotes.flavor: Each Stormscape apprentice must hand-raise and train an owl before attaining the rank of master.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
quotes.flavor: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

quotes.name: Deathcap Cultivator
quotes.flavor: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

quotes.name: Reality Shift
quotes.flavor: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dungeon Master Guide, *2nd Edition (1989)*

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: The Goblin's real genius, perhaps, was how he hid in plain sight of the city.

quotes.name: Malicious Eclipse
quotes.flavor: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness. At long last, his bloody reign would begin.

quotes.name: Horned Turtle
quotes.flavor: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

quotes.name: Rocket Launcher
quotes.flavor: What these devices lacked in subtlety, they made up in strength.

quotes.name: Dunland Crebain
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"What's that, Strider? It don't look like a cloud."
—Sam

quotes.name: Grapple with the Past
quotes.flavor: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

quotes.name: Repel the Darkness
quotes.flavor: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

quotes.name: Soul Diviner
quotes.flavor: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

quotes.name: Borne Upon a Wind
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Witching Well
quotes.flavor: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Leading from behind had never been her style.

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: Dissolutions Increasing—Are Varmints to Blame?

quotes.name: Steel Overseer
quotes.flavor: In an unusual foray into the humanoid form, Venand Kapur—known as the Gearherder—built this automaton to keep watch over his clockwork herds.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Tower
quotes.flavor: Living metal encasing dying flesh.

quotes.name: Prismwake Merrow
quotes.flavor: "Seeing is believing" is a fact the merrows ruthlessly exploit in their dealings with the other residents of Shadowmoor.

quotes.name: Needle Drop
quotes.flavor:
"First it was plovers and mulldrifters. Now it's knitting needles the size of javelins."
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

quotes.name: Taunt from the Rampart
quotes.flavor:
"Wotta revoltin' development."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Voltaic Visionary // Volt-Charged Berserker
quotes.flavor: She finally realized that chaos was meant to run rampant, as was she.

quotes.name: Doctor Octopus, Master Planner
quotes.flavor: "Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"

quotes.name: Timberwatch Elf
quotes.flavor: "If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."

quotes.name: Slate of Ancestry
quotes.flavor: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

quotes.name: Mothrider Samurai
quotes.flavor: When the night blossoms open, the wings of Eiganjo take flight.

quotes.name: Sarinth Greatwurm
quotes.flavor: It felt the rumblings of war and uncoiled itself from the depths of the world.

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

quotes.name: Coercion
quotes.flavor:
A rhino's bargain
—Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"

quotes.name: Donate
quotes.flavor: Campus pranksters initiate new students with the old "beeble bomb" routine.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Goblin Trailblazer
quotes.flavor:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Waking Nightmare
quotes.flavor:
"Once each year, the oni and other evil spirits paraded through villages to disturb mortals' sleep. During the war, this parade became a nightly event."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Goblin Gaveleer
quotes.flavor:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

quotes.name: Release the Dogs
quotes.flavor: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Mageta's Boon
quotes.flavor:
When the Lion roars, his cubs grow stronger.
—Kipamu saying

quotes.name: Mephitic Vapors
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

quotes.name: Ankh of Mishra
quotes.flavor: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle: the strange structures did not house Mishra's malevolent creations but were themselves among his creations.

quotes.name: Nature's Panoply
quotes.flavor: Nature protects its own.

quotes.name: Whirlwind
quotes.flavor: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

quotes.name: Tempest Djinn
quotes.flavor: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

quotes.name: Young Wolf
quotes.flavor: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor: "It's time for the 'Smash, Smash' song!"

quotes.name: Prophet of Kruphix
quotes.flavor: "Time is fluid as a dance, and truth as fleeting."

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Wielding the Green Dragon
quotes.flavor: Named for the eastern part of the sky, the source of energy and renewal, Guan Yu's crescent-moon blade weighed over 100 pounds.

quotes.name: Deadly Complication
quotes.flavor:
"Etrata was in custody long before Teysa was killed. It's impossible that she could be the culprit."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Bogbrew Witch
quotes.flavor: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

quotes.name: Field of Ruin
quotes.flavor:
"There's some devilry at work in the Shire."
—Sam

quotes.name: Iridescent Tiger
quotes.flavor: The power of the dragonstorms transformed not only the land but many of the creatures within it.

quotes.name: The Fall of Lord Konda // Fragment of Konda
quotes.flavor: For his transgressions against the kami, Lord Konda's immortal body was turned to stone, then shattered into a thousand still-living pieces.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: In places where the sea meets the trees, it's easy to forget the darkness that rules most of Innistrad.

quotes.name: Monstrous Rage
quotes.flavor:
「怒りはどこまでも私たちを歪め、壊してしまう。」
――「復讐心とその発露」

quotes.name: Lonely Sandbar
quotes.flavor:
"I do not believe that the world about us will ever again be as it was of old. For the Elves may soon pass to the Sea unhindered and leave Middle-earth forever."
—Haldir

quotes.name: Windgrace's Judgment
quotes.flavor: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

quotes.name: Harness Infinity
quotes.flavor:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy

quotes.name: Golden-Tail Disciple
quotes.flavor: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

quotes.name: Minion Reflector
quotes.flavor: To crack a mirror is to provide an opening for the reflection to escape.

quotes.name: Beast of Burden
quotes.flavor: The heavier the load, the harder it works.

quotes.name: Cat-Owl
quotes.flavor: When it's feeling bored, it chases itself.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

quotes.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
quotes.flavor: A dictator's infuriating smirk, an affront to everything Ravnica stood for.

quotes.name: Killer Whale
quotes.flavor: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

quotes.name: Crowned Ceratok
quotes.flavor: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

quotes.name: Inside Out
quotes.flavor: Seyden's temperament didn't take well to the puca's magic. Nor did his face.

quotes.name: Words of Wilding
quotes.flavor:
"Instinct is undaunted by terror, unchained by logic. It is the path from which all other paths diverge."
—*Volume V, The Book of Life*

quotes.name: Emcee
quotes.flavor: The ogre appealed the match loss and got it downgraded to a warning.

quotes.name: Pradesh Gypsies
quotes.flavor:
"A mysterious people indeed. Their origins are as secret as their traditions."
—Lord Magnus of Llanowar

quotes.name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
quotes.flavor: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

quotes.name: Costume Shop
quotes.flavor: Outfits you'll love at prices you'll tolerate.

quotes.name: Armorcraft Judge
quotes.flavor: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

quotes.name: Harvest Season
quotes.flavor: A true reflection of nature: death fostering life.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

quotes.name: Terrific Team-Up
quotes.flavor:
"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Auger Spree
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

quotes.name: Deicide
quotes.flavor:
"It is done."
—Elspeth

quotes.name: Obsidian Giant
quotes.flavor: After a while, ships stopped sailing within his reach.

quotes.name: Spiteful Bully
quotes.flavor: Like most creatures bent on total destruction, they rarely bother to double-check their targets.

quotes.name: Lovestruck Beast // Heart's Desire
quotes.flavor: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

quotes.name: Mycosynth Wellspring
quotes.flavor: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Shivan Reef
quotes.flavor: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

quotes.name: Perimeter Enforcer
quotes.flavor: He makes sure no one sets foot in a fresh crime scene—not even himself.

quotes.name: Storm Herd
quotes.flavor:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

quotes.name: Gavony Silversmith
quotes.flavor: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

quotes.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno
quotes.flavor: "Let the flames burn within you! No... let them burn without!"

quotes.name: Tainted Sigil
quotes.flavor: Sigils corrupted by outsiders do not lose their power, only their purity.

quotes.name: Catapult Master
quotes.flavor: "There's no 'I' in 'team,' but there's a 'we' in 'weapon.'"

quotes.name: Hypothesizzle
quotes.flavor:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

quotes.name: Hypothesizzle
quotes.flavor:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

quotes.name: Crypt Angel
quotes.flavor: Once an angel, now an abomination.

quotes.name: Pradesh Gypsies
quotes.flavor:
"A mysterious people indeed. Their origins are as secret as their traditions."
—Lord Magnus of Llanowar

quotes.name: Sultai Charm
quotes.flavor: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

quotes.name: Into the Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Wonders hide where the trees grow thickest."
—Mul Daya proverb

quotes.name: Return to the Sewers
quotes.flavor:
"We strike hard and fade away into the night."
—Leonardo

quotes.name: Electrolyze
quotes.flavor: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

quotes.name: Demon of Loathing
quotes.flavor: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

quotes.name: Quinjet Technician
quotes.flavor:
"We're powered up here, folks. And I added a few toys I think you're really going to like."
—Fabian Stankiewicz

quotes.name: Might of the Ancestors
quotes.flavor: Malamet histories speak of a time when they were not yet confined to mortal bodies and existed as ferocity unrestrained.

quotes.name: Harnessed Snubhorn
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.

quotes.name: Headsplitter
quotes.flavor: Your own personal problem-solver.

quotes.name: Dread Summons
quotes.flavor:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Now I realize that banishment is far too merciful a penalty for treason. Your penalty will be far steeper."
—Ozai, to Zuko

quotes.name: Essence Drain
quotes.flavor: Mephidross claims all life within it. What cannot be twisted is absorbed.

quotes.name: Bear Cub
quotes.flavor:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

quotes.name: Aid the Fallen
quotes.flavor: "I never liked you. Now get up—we have a fight to finish."

quotes.name: Dreamstone Hedron
quotes.flavor: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

quotes.name: Honorable Scout
quotes.flavor: "I've faced your kind before. This time I'm ready for you."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Atlas
quotes.flavor: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.

quotes.name: Throw from the Saddle
quotes.flavor:
"A little kindness would've carried you a lot farther than those spurs."
—Miriam, herd whisperer

quotes.name: Rewind
quotes.flavor:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Blood Pet
quotes.flavor: "You are wrong," Volrath said. "I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me." And then he laughed.

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Runebound Wolf
quotes.flavor: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.

quotes.name: Discerning Peddler
quotes.flavor: "Can I interest you in some herbs from Naktamun? Fresh from the Omenpath! Or a set of Fioran cookware? Finest in the Multiverse!"

quotes.name: Talarian Hook Spider
quotes.flavor:
"Well, I had a choice. Do I walk away and let the emitter blow itself to hell? Or do I crawl in the Jefferies tube with twenty hook spiders?"
—Chief Miles O'Brien

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata

quotes.name: Brilliant Restoration
quotes.flavor:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal

quotes.name: Brainsurge
quotes.flavor: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

quotes.name: Claws of Gix
quotes.flavor: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand. They enshrined it, hoping that one day it would point the way to Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Feign Death
quotes.flavor: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

quotes.name: Takeno's Cavalry
quotes.flavor: At night he perfected his aim, shooting spiderwebs by starlight.

quotes.name: Photon, Lady of Light
quotes.flavor: In the darkest times, she shines brightest.

quotes.name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
quotes.flavor: Everything in her wake stills, then stops.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Dark Banishing
quotes.flavor:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

quotes.name: Dowsing Dagger // Lost Vale
quotes.flavor: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

quotes.name: Panharmonicon
quotes.flavor: The difference between surviving and living is joy.

quotes.name: Stolen by the Fae
quotes.flavor: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

quotes.name: Necrobite
quotes.flavor: An undead snake doesn't bite in self-defense. It hungers as any zombie, never sated.

quotes.name: Soul Salvage
quotes.flavor: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Fog Bank
quotes.flavor:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

quotes.name: Sungrass Prairie
quotes.flavor:
"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something."
—Bill Potts

quotes.name: Aetherize
quotes.flavor: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor: The knight knelt and prayed, first for the sanctity of his land and second for the strength to repel its invaders.

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

quotes.name: Soulmender
quotes.flavor: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

quotes.name: Graven Cairns
quotes.flavor:
"At times we were friendly rivals, and at times we were simply friends. We'd always talk about our dreams... Like which of us would be first to sail beyond the sky to the stars."
—Setzer Gabbiani

quotes.name: Oxidda Golem
quotes.flavor: The longer it patrols the smoldering crags of the Oxidda Chain, the more it adopts their fiery temper.

quotes.name: Branching Evolution
quotes.flavor: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

quotes.name: Blackcleave Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"Bitten? Save time, amputate now."
—Lephar, loxodon surgeon

quotes.name: Murasa Brute
quotes.flavor: Some adventuring parties are made up of old friends, their common bonds bolstering them in the face of peril. Other parties simply hire the biggest, meanest muscle they can find.

quotes.name: Traumatize
quotes.flavor: He was left with just enough memory to understand what he had lost.

quotes.name: Moonglove Extract
quotes.flavor: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

quotes.name: Render Inert
quotes.flavor: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The *compleated* invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

quotes.name: Wind Drake
quotes.flavor:
"But high she shoots through air and light,
Above all low delay,
Where nothing earthly bounds her flight,
Nor shadow dims her way."
—Thomas Moore, "Oh that I had Wings"

quotes.name: Professor of Zoomancy
quotes.flavor: She's brilliant, if a bit overbearing.

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Iron Lad, Young Avenger
quotes.flavor: "I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."

quotes.name: Cloudstone Curio
quotes.flavor: Aragorn took the green stone and held it up, and there came a green fire from his hand.

quotes.name: Frostboil Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"We're on the Thames. The last great Frost Fair. 1814, February the 4th."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Channel
quotes.flavor:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

quotes.name: Aether Flash
quotes.flavor: As the foul beast appeared, arcane lightning crackled around it.

quotes.name: Phoebe, Head of S.N.E.A.K.
quotes.flavor: This space intentionally left blank.

quotes.name: Primal Vigor
quotes.flavor: "With Bast's strength, I will defend this land."

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Applied Geometry
quotes.flavor: "I know the prompt was to replicate a scurrid, but I took some creative liberties with my version."

quotes.name: Burning-Tree Vandal
quotes.flavor: The ostentatious splendor of the Orzhov church was just asking to be smashed.

quotes.name: Kindled Fury
quotes.flavor:
"It is most honorable to use every part of the animals we kill . . . especially if we use them to annihilate our enemies."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

quotes.name: Aether Storm
quotes.flavor:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

quotes.name: Eelectrocute
quotes.flavor: The midway's games aren't so much rigged as they are insulated and grounded.

quotes.name: Furious Resistance
quotes.flavor:
"At least the Gateless rebels have ideals. Rakdos just mocks, defiles, and kills all we hold dear."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Copy Enchantment
quotes.flavor: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

quotes.name: Leery Fogbeast
quotes.flavor: It emerges from the mists only to feed.

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: "I rely not so much on the wisdom of age as on the overconfidence of youth."

quotes.name: Smallpox
quotes.flavor:
「ある次元の毒は、別の次元では奇跡の特効薬です。ある次元の命を脅かすほどの伝染病は、別の次元ではありふれた風邪です。次元にまたがった医療機関は、計り知れないほど多くの命を救いうるのです。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

quotes.name: Reward the Faithful
quotes.flavor: "When you have drunk your fill, pass the cup to others who thirst."

quotes.name: Chemister's Insight
quotes.flavor: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

quotes.name: Dawntreader Elk
quotes.flavor: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

quotes.name: Essence Feed
quotes.flavor: Eldrazi grow wherever something else dies.

quotes.name: Kor Haven
quotes.flavor: The chief city of the Kings of Men was Osgiliath, Citadel of the Stars. Now it is deserted, and in its ruins shadows walk.

quotes.name: Grab the Prize
quotes.flavor: Unfortunately, the keyhole turned out to be located in an even larger, scarier clown mouth.

quotes.name: Spirit Link
quotes.flavor:
"I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power—far better to live with animals innocent of such ambitions."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: Spider-Girl, Legacy Hero
quotes.flavor: On Earth-982, May "Mayday" Parker, the first child of Peter and Mary Jane, continues her father's legacy.

quotes.name: Soul's Majesty
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of wisdom and strength.

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Tranquil Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Even the fiercest storm has a peaceful eye."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Dredge the Mire
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, the reanimation spell just missed the long-dead colony of dung scorpions.

quotes.name: Leatherback Baloth
quotes.flavor: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

quotes.name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
quotes.flavor: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor: A witch once foretold that Glavin would die surrounded by unimaginable wealth. Until that moment, he'd taken that to mean he'd be rich.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"When facing a crisis, don't forget to squeeze your official Vault-Tec stress ball!"
—*Overseer's Manual*

quotes.name: Impassioned Orator
quotes.flavor: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

quotes.name: Reach Through Mists
quotes.flavor:
"Know one part of the name, obsession begins. Know two parts, paranoia sets in. Know three parts, madness descends. Know all, and only the kami know what will become of you."
—Lady Azami

quotes.name: Selfless Savior
quotes.flavor: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: "This cogitator provides a strategic overview of the battlefield. By which I mean, of course, the entire planet."

quotes.name: Zhur-Taa Swine
quotes.flavor: Gurley was the first to domesticate one, though his widow didn't take much solace in that accomplishment.

quotes.name: Authority of the Consuls
quotes.flavor: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

quotes.name: Viridian Joiner
quotes.flavor: "The Tangle reaches out to itself constantly, forming new connections. We must follow its example."

quotes.name: Squandered Resources
quotes.flavor:
"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Take Up the Shield
quotes.flavor: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor: All that glitters is yours.

quotes.name: Sea Gate Oracle
quotes.flavor: "The secret entrance should be near."

quotes.name: Vampire Bats
quotes.flavor:
"For something is amiss or out of place / When mice with wings can wear a human face."
—Theodore Roethke, "The Bat"

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

quotes.name: Deathbloom Gardener
quotes.flavor: "I can provide the Coalition with poisons that will break down Phyrexian machinery as easily as they stop the heart."

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Feline Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Dogs beg. Cats lay claim.

quotes.name: Knighthood
quotes.flavor: Kings don't make knights. Actions do.

quotes.name: Sabertooth Wyvern
quotes.flavor: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

quotes.name: Malfegor
quotes.flavor: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

quotes.name: Crackdown Construct
quotes.flavor:
"All buildings are subject to search. Resistance will be punished."
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

quotes.name: Spearbreaker Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Few Nayans dare hunt the gargantuans. They're regarded not as animals but as forces of nature, like landslides or typhoons.

quotes.name: Premature Burial
quotes.flavor:
"This soil knows well the taste of the dead. Give it the hunger for a living meal, and it can become a deadly ally."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

quotes.name: Touch of Brilliance
quotes.flavor: "I don't want what I don't have. I want more of what I *do* have."

quotes.name: Vantress Transmuter // Croaking Curse
quotes.flavor: "My orders were to capture you alive. They didn't specify in what form."

quotes.name: Cartographer's Survey
quotes.flavor: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.

quotes.name: Thunder Drake
quotes.flavor: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

quotes.name: Raise Dead
quotes.flavor: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

quotes.name: Knight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth Tirel

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Angel of Jubilation
quotes.flavor: "Though Innistrad is not cleansed of evil, we finally have cause to rejoice."

quotes.name: Apothecary Geist
quotes.flavor: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

quotes.name: Temple of Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri

quotes.name: Guise of Fire
quotes.flavor:
"Fire will eventually destroy a zombie, but a fiery zombie destroys a lot of other things first."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

quotes.name: Heron's Grace Champion
quotes.flavor: Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.

quotes.name: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff
quotes.flavor: As the sagas tell it, Jorn collects a sliver of ice from every realm he visits.

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

quotes.name: Dispatch
quotes.flavor:
"I'll take the chopper! The bikes are all yours, Cloud!"
—Barret Wallace

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Duneblast
quotes.flavor: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

quotes.name: Unwilling Ingredient
quotes.flavor:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

quotes.name: Stroke of Genius
quotes.flavor: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

quotes.name: Uncover the Moon-Letters
quotes.flavor: Elrond took the map and gazed long at it, and he shook his head, until he saw what the moon revealed.

quotes.name: Luke Cage, Hero for Hire
quotes.flavor: "Sweet Christmas!"

quotes.name: Pendrell Flux
quotes.flavor: Devoured by the mists, Tolaria was stuck in time, trapped between two eternal heartbeats.

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Eternal of Harsh Truths
quotes.flavor:
"If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Armored Griffin
quotes.flavor: When an order for griffin barding comes in, blacksmiths prepare their forges for months of exacting work. They know griffins always detect imperfections and never haggle.

quotes.name: Balm of Restoration
quotes.flavor:
"Not all armies enjoyed the services of a medic. For them, Balm of Restoration was that much more valuable."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

quotes.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
quotes.flavor: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

quotes.name: Promise of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: "It's us against the world. Forever."

quotes.name: Elite Archers
quotes.flavor: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

quotes.name: Happy Hogan, Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: "Move along folks. Move along."

quotes.name: Builder's Bane
quotes.flavor: There is only so much a person may be buried with.

quotes.name: Fallowsage
quotes.flavor: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

quotes.name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
quotes.flavor:
"That little fella is deadly in his own fashion."
—The Mariner

quotes.name: Silumgar Butcher
quotes.flavor: Silumgar takes pride in the diversity of his sibsig.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Impetuous Sunchaser
quotes.flavor: "I will soar higher than the walls of Akros! Higher than the clouds! Higher than Heliod himself!"

quotes.name: Lash of the Balrog
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Even as the Balrog fell, it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about Gandalf's knees, dragging him to the brink of the abyss. "Fly, you fools!" he cried, and was gone.

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Let the others bicker over their little worlds and stars. I have an empire of knowledge, and it encompasses all others."
—Trazyn the Infinite

quotes.name: Archetype of Finality
quotes.flavor: She sees mortals not as they wish to be, but as what they will become.

quotes.name: Skyship Buccaneer
quotes.flavor:
"It's a pirate's nature to be free of law. Gravity is no exception."
—Kari Zev, skyship captain

quotes.name: Ferris Wheel
quotes.flavor: After a certain point, it becomes more of a prison than a ride.

quotes.name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
quotes.flavor: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

quotes.name: Welkin Tern
quotes.flavor: Sailors have come to regard them as bad luck, for they falsely bring hope of land.

quotes.name: Karplusan Giant
quotes.flavor:
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of Giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Driver of the Dead
quotes.flavor: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

quotes.name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
quotes.flavor: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

quotes.name: Strategic Planning
quotes.flavor:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Call the Spirit Dragons
quotes.flavor: The Stormnexus Ritual brought forth draconic protectors, but unleashed the chaos of storms.

quotes.name: Ashiok's Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Every nightmare is a caged bird that yearns to be set free."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Falkenrath Perforator
quotes.flavor: "Lady Anje sends her regards. I'll carve the rest of her message into your skin."

quotes.name: Grim Strider
quotes.flavor:
"As a child I saw something walking in the distance, far beyond the Hekma—shadow-dark, and taller than the gods. Even now, it passes through my dreams."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop

quotes.name: Sylvan Safekeeper
quotes.flavor:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

quotes.name: Tenacity
quotes.flavor: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.flavor:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

quotes.name: Gorilla Warrior
quotes.flavor: The gorilla beat its chest and threw great handfuls of leaves into the air. It howled challenge and showed its teeth. The mechanical soldier, not understanding, simply killed it.

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

quotes.name: Dauthi Mercenary
quotes.flavor:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Warped Researcher
quotes.flavor: New insights yield new senses.

quotes.name: Scuttling Butler
quotes.flavor: Porter, cleaner, and bouncer all in one.

quotes.name: Search the Premises
quotes.flavor:
"To halt these lurid practices, Geralf must be found and made an example of."
—Inquisitor Delmund

quotes.name: Tune Up
quotes.flavor:
"For most people? The odds would be insurmountable," Daretti said.
"But we're not most people," Pia replied.

quotes.name: Phyresis
quotes.flavor:
"Perfection is at hand. You have been freed of weakness and made *compleat*."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
quotes.flavor: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

quotes.name: Myr Retriever
quotes.flavor: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

quotes.name: Syncopate
quotes.flavor: The fire spell stuttered and broke. Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Retaliator Griffin
quotes.flavor: For every eye, an eye. For every tooth, a tooth. Griffins are nothing if not fair.

quotes.name: Lotus Cobra
quotes.flavor: Its passage through the flowering expanse doesn't disturb so much as a single petal.

quotes.name: Wake the Reflections
quotes.flavor:
"You see a bird, an oak, a packbeast. I see the potential for an army."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

quotes.name: Coordinated Clobbering
quotes.flavor: Zimone's theory was that the fractalization of atmospheric aether would increase kinetic energy. Tyvar's theory was that if you hit cultists in the face really hard, they would fall down. They were both right.

quotes.name: Costly Plunder
quotes.flavor: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

quotes.name: Turbulent Wilderness
quotes.flavor:
"Existence is more perfect, more informative and unknowable, than the cleverest theorem ever devised."
—Tanazir Quandrix

quotes.name: Elvish Fury
quotes.flavor: Fail to respect the forest and you will fertilize it.

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Goblin Outlander
quotes.flavor: Egbol stared in wonder at Naya's landscape. So much to eat. So much to steal.

quotes.name: Snapping Drake
quotes.flavor: The irritable drakes are solitary nesters. Even brooding females barely contain the urge to attack their own young.

quotes.name: Drudge Beetle
quotes.flavor: The Street Swarm is the labor class that drives the Golgari's endless cycle of life and death.

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

quotes.name: Flowstone Overseer
quotes.flavor: The rebels couldn't see where the roar was coming from. Then they saw it was coming from everywhere.

quotes.name: Abzan Falconer
quotes.flavor: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

quotes.name: Earsplitting Rats
quotes.flavor: Rats come in one amount: too many.

quotes.name: Citanul Hierophants
quotes.flavor: "All who inhabit these woods are part of our ritual, whether they realize it or not."

quotes.name: Dralnu's Crusade
quotes.flavor:
"Don't you agree that mogg intellects are improved by zombification?"
—Lord Dralnu

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

quotes.name: Thijarian Witness
quotes.flavor: "We honor the lost as we cannot honor our own."

quotes.name: Liliana Vess // Liliana Vess
quotes.flavor:
Signature Magic: Necromancy
Color Alignment: Black
Plane of Origin: Dominaria
First Planeswalk: Innistrad
Height: 5'9"
Stole 23 bases last season, refuses to return them.

quotes.name: Crested Sunmare
quotes.flavor:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

quotes.name: Nomad Decoy
quotes.flavor: If you can take something from a nomad, it's probably bait.

quotes.name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
quotes.flavor: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the *plants* have an attitude?"

quotes.name: Fling
quotes.flavor: Masters of the sword know the blade is not the only weapon at their disposal.

quotes.name: Reflecting Pool
quotes.flavor: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?

quotes.name: Parch
quotes.flavor:
"Your porous flesh betrays you."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

quotes.name: Willow Geist
quotes.flavor: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

quotes.name: Trygon Predator
quotes.flavor: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

quotes.name: Sculpting Steel
quotes.flavor: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

quotes.name: Dalek Drone
quotes.flavor: "Elevate."

quotes.name: Military Intelligence
quotes.flavor: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

quotes.name: Sunlit Hoplite
quotes.flavor: "Even in her absence, the light Elspeth kindled in our hearts never faltered."

quotes.name: Vengeful Devil
quotes.flavor: Devils love adding injury to injury.

quotes.name: Rat King, Pale Piper
quotes.flavor: "Every chessboard requires pawns. Tonight, my pawn, I'll find out just how strong you are."

quotes.name: Void Attendant
quotes.flavor: The Eldrazi don't merely extinguish life—they supplant it.

quotes.name: Living Twister
quotes.flavor:
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!"
—Nikya of the Old Ways

quotes.name: Aether Adept
quotes.flavor: "The universe is my instrument, and the song I play upon it is one you are forbidden to hear."

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Druid
quotes.flavor:
"All struggles ultimately require sacrifice. It's just that some sacrifices are dearer than others."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

quotes.name: Tireless Hauler // Dire-Strain Brawler
quotes.flavor: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.

quotes.name: Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "You are not the only one who found a way to live across the ages, Captain America."

quotes.name: Kithkin Zealot
quotes.flavor: The more his flock fears, the more power he wields.

quotes.name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
quotes.flavor:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor:
"It's only torture if you're strong enough to survive. Otherwise, it's a simple, gruesome death. I'm happy either way."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Hydroid Krasis
quotes.flavor: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

quotes.name: Perforator Crocodile
quotes.flavor: The tag on its toe read "deceased." It vehemently disagreed.

quotes.name: Dragon Sniper
quotes.flavor: During Dromoka's reign, Qatros Karst City was a haven for the Abzan rebellion. Its current residents have not lost their proficiency against their former foes.

quotes.name: Rootwater Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"Ugh! When did orcs and fish start having kids?"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Alirios, Enraptured
quotes.flavor: "Why would I ever want to look away?"

quotes.name: Twinshot Sniper
quotes.flavor: "Pierce the heart and pierce the head, even the mightiest fall down dead."

quotes.name: Venerable Lammasu
quotes.flavor: Lammasu are the enigmatic travelers of Tarkir, soaring high above all lands in all seasons. None know their true purpose, but they often arrive on the eve of great conflicts or turning points in history.

quotes.name: Portcullis Vine
quotes.flavor: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

quotes.name: Glimmerbell
quotes.flavor:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
quotes.flavor: Like her well of stories, Birgi's horn never runs dry.

quotes.name: Gau, Feral Youth
quotes.flavor: "Uwao! Aooh! I'm Gau! Your friend! Frieeend!!!"

quotes.name: Snarling Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

quotes.name: Phantom Warrior
quotes.flavor: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

quotes.name: Mystical Tether
quotes.flavor: Kellan had no plan. He simply poured his focus into the train and willed it to stop.

quotes.name: Mastermind's Acquisition
quotes.flavor: Another piece of a nefarious puzzle.

quotes.name: Grasp of the Hieromancer
quotes.flavor:
"There is power in abandon, but far more in control."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

quotes.name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
quotes.flavor: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

quotes.name: Warrior en-Kor
quotes.flavor: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

quotes.name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
quotes.flavor: "Benalia stands for hope and light. I pledge my blade to any that fall under its banner."

quotes.name: Viashino Sandscout
quotes.flavor: A viashino's overlapping scales form a buffer against Shiv's ash-flecked winds and a slippery target for goblin pikes.

quotes.name: Akroan Conscriptor
quotes.flavor: "The time to serve is now."

quotes.name: Foul Orchard
quotes.flavor: On Amonkhet, death is an ever-present part of life.

quotes.name: Kavu Predator
quotes.flavor: In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"Let others a journey new begin,
But I at last with weary feet
Will turn towards the lighted inn,
My evening-rest and sleep to meet."
—Bilbo's song

quotes.name: Jade Statue
quotes.flavor:
"The paradox of jade statues is that their victims never really expect attack, but they are never completely surprised either."
—Kabel, Tolarian archivist

quotes.name: Western Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Expect nothing but scorn, flattery, and lies. And never turn your back on him."
—Northern paladin

quotes.name: Fallen Angel
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

quotes.name: Needleshot Gourna
quotes.flavor: The first aven scout squad returned from Krosa with disturbing stories. The second returned with disturbing casualties.

quotes.name: Grim Flowering
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing in nature goes to waste, not even the rotting corpse of a good-for-nothing, blood-sucking vampire."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

quotes.name: Dark Deal
quotes.flavor: Dungeon Master's Guide, *Revised 5th Edition, cover art sketch (2024)*

quotes.name: Sea Gate Oracle
quotes.flavor: "The secret entrance should be near."

quotes.name: Sun-Blessed Peak
quotes.flavor: The sacred site of firebending's first spark.

quotes.name: Street Wraith
quotes.flavor: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

quotes.name: Lava Burst
quotes.flavor:
"Overkill? This isn't a game of kick-the-ouphe!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Fiery Conclusion
quotes.flavor: The Boros legionnaire saw a noble sacrifice, the Rakdos thug a blazing suicide, and the Izzet alchemist an experiment gone awry.

quotes.name: Root Spider
quotes.flavor:
"They're not half as fierce if they don't see you coming."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

quotes.name: Reckless Blaze
quotes.flavor: Aang learned the hard way not to play with fire.

quotes.name: Ezuri's Archers
quotes.flavor: Eyes and arrows trained ever skyward.

quotes.name: Charging Griffin
quotes.flavor: Four claws, two wings, one beak, no fear.

quotes.name: Defenestrate
quotes.flavor: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

quotes.name: Inspired Tinkering
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "What do you mean 'Does it work?' What an insulting question."

quotes.name: Multiversal Passage
quotes.flavor: New worlds await...

quotes.name: Gigantic Big Bear
quotes.flavor: Wargs and Goblins had few predators in the foothills of the Misty Mountains, but they did have some.

quotes.name: Underground River
quotes.flavor:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Outflank
quotes.flavor:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

quotes.name: Valgavoth's Lair
quotes.flavor: It is the one chamber whose location never changes, the rotten, rancorous heart of Duskmourn itself.

quotes.name: Eumidian Terrabotanist
quotes.flavor:
To plant the seeds of the other is to cultivate the self.
—Eumidian aphorism

quotes.name: Werebear
quotes.flavor: To become is to understand.

quotes.name: Imaryll, Elfhame Elite
quotes.flavor: The elvish kingdoms of Llanowar are united in their distrust of outsiders.

quotes.name: Smoke Teller
quotes.flavor: "See your enemies from a thousand sides. Then you will find a thousand ways to kill them."

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser,
*The Faerie Queene*

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Lavalanche
quotes.flavor: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

quotes.name: Order of the White Shield
quotes.flavor:
"Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

quotes.name: Beast of Burden
quotes.flavor: The heavier the load, the harder it works.

quotes.name: Watercourser
quotes.flavor:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

quotes.name: Quarry Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"The ruin of the past is the topsoil of the future."
—Sokar, former Nef-crop initiate

quotes.name: Enlarge
quotes.flavor: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

quotes.name: Explore
quotes.flavor: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.

quotes.name: Spectral Searchlight
quotes.flavor: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: Phyrexian Grimoire
quotes.flavor: Every page cost a life; every secret cost a thousand more.

quotes.name: Vicious Rivalry
quotes.flavor: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

quotes.name: Starlit Angel
quotes.flavor: To soar as high as hope, to dive as swift as justice.

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Butcher's Glee
quotes.flavor: The Crave made Kneecleaver think she was bigger than the dragon.

quotes.name: Voltaic Visionary // Volt-Charged Berserker
quotes.flavor: She spent many years trying to harness chaos.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

quotes.name: Dismal Backwater
quotes.flavor: The Invasion Tree's branches snaked through the streets of Otawara, turning Kamigawa's soaring city into a clouded nightmare.

quotes.name: Treasure Map // Treasure Cove
quotes.flavor: Half the treasure is the glory of finding it.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law-strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Valkyrie Harbinger
quotes.flavor: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Ghoul's Feast
quotes.flavor: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."

quotes.name: Gatstaf Shepherd // Gatstaf Howler
quotes.flavor:
"What is worse than a wolf in sheep's clothing?"
—Wolfhunter's riddle

quotes.name: Brash Taunter
quotes.flavor: "Why don't you come a little closer and say that again, you spineless spit-licker!"

quotes.name: Anger of the Gods
quotes.flavor:
"Toralf struck the ground with his hammer, and the force of a thousand storms tore through the demonic horde."
—Birgi, god of storytelling

quotes.name: Entity Tracker
quotes.flavor: "The readings are off the charts! Whatever it is, it's close."

quotes.name: Jaded Response
quotes.flavor:
"Calm down everyone; it's nothing we haven't seen before."
—Sisay

quotes.name: Selfless Glyphweaver // Deadly Vanity
quotes.flavor: She cast a spell to purge all weakness. When the ink cleared, she stood alone.

quotes.name: Golgari Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.

quotes.name: War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

quotes.name: Cataclysm
quotes.flavor: The *Weatherlight* dragged the Predator behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

quotes.name: Bumper Cars
quotes.flavor: The engineers figured out a way to make the crashes power the ride itself. The energy surplus alone is enough to run the deep fryer.

quotes.name: Disrupting Scepter
quotes.flavor: "True power is controlling not only the hearts of your subjects, but their minds as well."

quotes.name: Read the Bones
quotes.flavor: Learn anything you want to know— and everything you don't.

quotes.name: Sphinx's Decree
quotes.flavor:
"Be still."
—Azor

quotes.name: Honor the Fallen
quotes.flavor:
"May the River claim Cho-Manno's body, wherever it lies."
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

quotes.name: Behemoth Sledge
quotes.flavor: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

quotes.name: Devilish Valet
quotes.flavor: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.

quotes.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
quotes.flavor: "What's behind my mask? My face, idiot."

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: Cuando quema gente, se quedan quemados.

quotes.name: Death Frenzy
quotes.flavor: The crocodiles' putrid jaws swallow everything but the screams.

quotes.name: Blinking Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

quotes.name: Mindless Null
quotes.flavor: Only a bloodchief can create vampires. The rest sire nulls, who become mindless beasts in their former bodies.

quotes.name: Dry Spell
quotes.flavor:
"My soul thirsts for Serra's salvation, as does my body for life's breath."
—Ihsan's Shade

quotes.name: Fire Lord Azula
quotes.flavor: "I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother."

quotes.name: Fumarole
quotes.flavor:
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills."
—Klazina Jansdotter, leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

quotes.name: Last-Ditch Effort
quotes.flavor:
"If you're gonna lose, at least make sure they don't win as much."
—Jula, goblin raider

quotes.name: Awakening Zone
quotes.flavor: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Worn Powerstone
quotes.flavor: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

quotes.name: Sibsig Appraiser
quotes.flavor: "Oh, I can absolutely verify its authenticity," chuckled Sarnai. "I was there when it was made."

quotes.name: Steward of Valeron
quotes.flavor: www.MagicTheGathering.com

quotes.name: Sphinx of Magosi
quotes.flavor: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

quotes.name: Bird Admirer // Wing Shredder
quotes.flavor: Her hunger won't be sated until she's tasted every bird on Innistrad.

quotes.name: Behold the Sinister Six!
quotes.flavor: None of them could defeat Spider-Man alone. Together, they would be unstoppable.

quotes.name: Gaea's Embrace
quotes.flavor: The forest rose to the battle, not to save the people but to save itself.

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

quotes.name: Sea God's Revenge
quotes.flavor:
"What has neither mouth nor throat, yet swallows captain, crew, and boat?"
—Sphinx's riddle

quotes.name: Razorgrass Ambush // Razorgrass Field
quotes.flavor: When disturbed, razorgrass skewers unwary intruders in violent, jingling bursts.

quotes.name: Ghostflame Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"This breed is on the cusp of evolution. It burns away the markings that connect it to a queen that no longer heeds its call. It seeks a new master. Perhaps I can give it one."
—Freyalise

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Rhystic Shield
quotes.flavor: A shield for one is good. A shield for everyone is even better.

quotes.name: Mudhole
quotes.flavor: "Doing okay back there, Tarv? Tarv?"
